items.title: Hundreds of Sydney apartment buyers see $24m in deposits vanish
items.summary: Almost 300 home buyers were waiting to get the keys to their newly built apartments in Sydney's Dee Why and Blacktown.

items.title: Chevron Stocks Rise 1.06% as Brent Jumps 3.5% on Saudi Refinery Attack Claim
items.summary: Chevron outpaced a flat Exxon Mobil after Yemen's Houthis said they struck Ras Tanura, sending Brent to $94.61.

items.title: Flight Centre investigating mass cyber breach
items.summary: The travel agency has apologised as it investigates a cyber breach believed to have exposed a significant number of customer records, including passport details.

aus.headline: Sydney Buyers Lose $24m Deposits
aus.body: Almost 300 buyers of new flats in Dee Why and Blacktown have had their deposits vanish.
aus.why: Shows what is at stake for buyers of newly built apartments.

us.headline: Oil Jumps On Saudi Attack Claim
us.body: Brent climbed 3.5% to $94.61 as Yemen's Houthis claimed a strike on a Saudi refinery.
us.why: Global oil prices feed into what Australians pay at the bowser.

biz.headline: Flight Centre Probes Cyber Breach
biz.body: The travel firm is probing a hack that may have exposed customer passport details.
biz.why: Passport details are among the records believed to be exposed.
